title: Master Contract Provision: Termination of the Employer Group Contract
content:
**Termination.** An employer may end its Employer Group Contract on the segment's written notice period of 30 calendar days, effective at the end of the month in which the notice period ends, including during a rate guarantee when the segment allows early termination. Cascade ends the contract when the group billing account lapses for nonpayment, and does not renew it when a participation shortfall is not cured. Every enrollment under the contract ends on the contract termination date, and COBRA continuation then ends as well because the group no longer offers coverage.

The provision applies to every segment of the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series; an active contract moves to terminated on any of the grounds below.

## Termination date by ground

| Ground | Ended by | Contract termination date | Reason recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| The employer's written notice | the employer | the last day of the month in which the notice period ends | employer request |
| The group billing account lapses for nonpayment | Cascade | the paid-through date | nonpayment |
| A participation shortfall is not cured | Cascade, by not renewing | the day before the renewal date | participation failure |

## Effect on enrollments

On the contract termination date, the Dental PPO Plans, Vision Plans and Prepaid Dental HMO Plans enrollments under the contract end, each recorded as ended because the group terminated, and any COBRA continuation under the contract ends as well.

## Notice illustrations (hypothetical dates)

| Written notice received | Notice period of 30 calendar days ends | Contract ends |
|---|---|---|
| March 25 | April 24 | April 30 |
| June 10 | July 10 | July 31 |

A notice given while rates are still under a rate guarantee ends the contract on the same basis in a segment that allows early termination.
